name: positive-psychology
description: Reads how you explain real events, scores it the way the research does, and trains the ear by drilling your own sentences.

interface.shortDescription: Measure how you explain things, then train the ear
interface.longDescription: Reads how optimistic you are from the way you explain real events, using the three questions the research asks about a cause: does it last, how far does it reach, is it you or the situation. Then it drills your own sentences back at you until you hear the difference without being told.
